memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of Dan according to its clans. The territory of their inheritance included: Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh, Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah, Elon, Timnah, Ekron, Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath, Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon, Me Jarkon and Rakkon, with the area facing Joppa - Josh 19:40-46 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The seventh lot falls to Dan, giving them a portion in the fertile lowlands near the coast. On paper it was good land. Yet Dan's story would prove troubled. The tribe struggled to hold this territory against the strong peoples of the plains, and eventually many Danites gave up and migrated far to the north in search of an easier home. The good inheritance God had assigned was, in part, abandoned because holding it proved hard.

This is a sobering thread in Dan's story. God had given them a genuine portion, but pressing in to keep it required perseverance and faith they did not fully show. Rather than continuing to trust God for the harder ground, they looked for an easier path elsewhere. Their later history in the north would even become entangled with idolatry (Judg 18). What began with a God-given inheritance drifted, through discouragement and compromise, into trouble.

There is a gentle warning here for us. God's good gifts often come with the call to persevere, to hold on through difficulty rather than abandoning the ground when it gets hard. When we grow discouraged and start looking for an easier path away from where God has placed us, we can drift into compromise. The call of the gospel is to endure, to keep trusting God in the hard places rather than giving up. He gives grace to persevere, and it is those who hold fast to the end who receive the promise (Heb 10:36).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Are you tempted to abandon hard ground rather than persevere where God placed you?
- How can you keep trusting God in a difficult place instead of seeking an easier path?
- Where do you need grace to endure rather than give up?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when the ground gets hard, guard me from drifting toward easier paths and compromise. Give me grace to persevere where You have placed me, trusting You to the end. Amen.
